title: National Seashore Tour with Guided Hike from Provincetown
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the Cape Cod National Seashore and all its charm & beauty! Our first stop will be at Pilgrim Landing for stunning views of the farthest point of Cape Cod. As we travel into the National Seashore we'll have views of 2 of Provincetown's lighthouses, Wood's End and The Race Point Light House. Stopping at the Province lands Visitor’s Center you can explore the museum and amazing viewing deck of the dunes and Atlantic Ocean! From this vantage point there is a strong chance of seeing a variety of whales feeding just off the shores! We'll then make our way to the Beech Forest trail where you'll enjoy a guided mile loop hike around one of Cape Cod's famous ponds. Learn about the geology of the Cape as we travel through this unique, Nationally recognized Old Growth Forest. This is also a very popular birding spot, seasonal foraging and a local hiking favorite!
